description: Four people were stabbed outside a building in Vancouver's Downtown Eastside. Three men and one woman were taken to hospital. Police arrested a 17-year-old suspect.

title: Surrey Party Bus Stabbing
description: A fight aboard a party bus on Highway 1 resulted in four people being injured, including multiple victims with stab wounds. Two victims were taken to hospital with serious but non-life-threatening injuries.

title: North York Family Stabbing
venue: Residential home near Bathurst Street and Steeles Avenue
description: Four family members were stabbed inside a North York home. Two men suffered serious injuries and two women sustained non-life-threatening injuries. A suspect was arrested at the scene.

title: Airdrie Targeted Shooting and Vehicle Attack
description: A targeted attack involving multiple shots and a vehicle collision injured four people in Airdrie. Three victims suffered minor injuries and one was seriously injured.

title: Toronto Downtown Stabbing
description: Four men were injured in a stabbing and weapon assault in Toronto's Entertainment District. Two initially suffered life-threatening injuries and two others sustained less serious injuries.

title: Toronto Dundas Street Stabbing
venue: Dundas Street East and Sherbourne Street
description: Four people suffered stab wounds following a fight near Dundas Street East and Sherbourne Street. All four victims were transported to hospital with non-life-threatening injuries.

title: Toronto King West Stabbing
venue: King Street West and Portland Street
description: Four people were stabbed after a large fight in Toronto's King West area. Three victims were transported to hospital in serious condition and another sustained less serious injuries.

title: Edmonton Loblaws Warehouse Stabbing
description: A stabbing attack at a distribution warehouse in Edmonton killed two people and injured four others.

title: Toronto Ceridian Office Stabbing
description: Four employees were taken to hospital after a stabbing attack at a Toronto office during the dismissal of an employee.

title: Akulivik Stabbing Spree
description: A stabbing spree in the Nunavik community of Akulivik killed three victims and injured two others before the perpetrator was shot by police.

title: Quebec City Vehicle Attack
description: A vehicle was deliberately driven into two Canadian Armed Forces members in Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu. One victim died and another was injured. The perpetrator was subsequently shot and killed by police.

title: Edmonton Northside Vehicle Attack
description: A vehicle was deliberately driven into a police officer and pedestrians in downtown Edmonton, followed by a stabbing attack. One victim was killed and four others were injured.

title: Quebec City Mosque Attack
description: A gunman opened fire on worshippers at the Quebec Islamic Cultural Centre, killing six people and injuring 19 others.

title: Toronto Yonge Street Vehicle Attack
description: A rented van was deliberately driven into pedestrians along Yonge Street in Toronto. Ten victims died and 16 others were injured.

title: Toronto Kensington Market Shooting
description: Four people were shot near Kensington Market on Canada Day. One victim later died in hospital and three others survived.

title: Calgary Brentwood Stabbings
description: Five young adults were stabbed to death at a house party in Calgary's Brentwood neighbourhood.

title: Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu Attack
description: A vehicle attack targeting Canadian Armed Forces personnel killed one victim and injured another before the perpetrator was killed by police.

title: Quebec City Halloween Sword Attack
description: A man armed with a sword attacked people in Old Quebec on Halloween night, killing two victims and injuring five others.

title: Lynn Valley Stabbing
description: A stabbing attack at Lynn Valley Village and the nearby library killed one victim and injured six others.

title: London Ontario Vehicle Attack
venue: Hyde Park Road and South Carriage Road area
description: A pickup truck was deliberately driven into a Muslim family in London, Ontario. Four victims were killed and one child was seriously injured.

title: Saskatchewan Mass Stabbing
city: James Smith Cree Nation and Weldon
description: A series of stabbings at multiple locations in James Smith Cree Nation and Weldon killed 11 victims and injured 17 others.

title: Ottawa Barrhaven Mass Stabbing
description: Six members of a family were killed in a residential stabbing in Barrhaven, Ottawa. One additional family member survived with serious injuries.

title: Vancouver Lapu-Lapu Day Vehicle Attack
description: A vehicle was driven into crowds attending the Lapu-Lapu Day Filipino community festival in Vancouver, killing 11 victims and injuring 17 others.

title: Mannville Mass Shooting
description: Four victims were killed during a shooting in the Mannville area of Alberta.
sources: List of Mass Shootings in Canada

title: Quebec City Anti-Conscription Riot
description: Canadian military forces opened fire during violent anti-conscription riots in Quebec City. Four people were killed and approximately 100 people were injured.

title: Ottawa OC Transpo Shooting
venue: OC Transpo St. Laurent Boulevard garage
description: A former OC Transpo employee opened fire at the transit garage, killing four coworkers and injuring two others before dying by suicide. NHIRA excludes the perpetrator.

title: Sault Ste. Marie Family Shooting
description: Four victims were killed in connected residential shootings in Sault Ste. Marie and another victim was injured. The perpetrator subsequently died by suicide and is excluded from NHIRA fatalities.

title: Penticton Targeted Shooting Spree
description: Four victims, two men and two women, were fatally shot at multiple locations in Penticton. Police described the shootings as targeted and arrested a male suspect who surrendered to police.

title: Toronto Raptors Parade Shooting
description: Four people were wounded by gunfire during the Toronto Raptors championship celebration near Nathan Phillips Square. Three suspects were arrested shortly after the shooting.

title: Toronto CityPlace Airbnb Shooting
description: A shooting at a rented Airbnb in Toronto's CityPlace neighbourhood killed two victims and injured two others. A third person who died was identified as a suspect and is excluded from NHIRA fatalities.

title: Oshawa Family Shooting
description: Four members of a family were killed in a shooting at an Oshawa home. The perpetrator, an estranged relative, subsequently died by suicide and is excluded from NHIRA fatalities. One additional family member survived with gunshot injuries.

title: O'Chiese First Nation Shootings
description: Four people were injured in three separate shootings on O'Chiese First Nation west of Red Deer. All four victims were reported to have non-life-threatening injuries.

title: Mississauga Glen Erin Shooting
venue: Plaza near Glen Erin Drive and The Collegeway
description: One person was killed and four others were injured during a shooting at a Mississauga plaza. The four surviving victims were transported to hospitals and were expected to survive.

title: Montreal Shooting
description: Three victims were killed and two others were injured in connected shootings in Montreal.
sources: Service de police de la Ville de Montreal

title: Saanich Bank Shootout
description: Two armed suspects exchanged gunfire with responding police outside a Saanich bank. Both suspects were killed by police and six police officers were wounded. NHIRA excludes the two perpetrators from victim fatalities.
sources: Independent Investigations Office of British Columbia

title: Langley Shooting Spree
description: Two victims were killed and two others were injured during a series of shootings targeting homeless people in Langley. Police later shot and killed the perpetrator, who is excluded from NHIRA fatalities.
sources: Independent Investigations Office of British Columbia

title: Ajax Restaurant Party Shooting
venue: Restaurant area near Harwood Avenue South
description: Six people were injured in a shooting during a gathering behind a restaurant in Ajax. One victim was initially reported in life-threatening condition and five others also suffered gunshot wounds.

title: Montreal Shooting Spree
description: Four victims were killed during a series of shootings in Montreal occurring between August 2 and August 4.
sources: Service de police de la Ville de Montreal

title: Mississauga-Milton Shooting Spree
description: A series of shootings in Mississauga and Milton killed three victims and injured two others. The perpetrator was later killed by police and is excluded from NHIRA fatalities.

title: Vaughan Condominium Shooting
description: Five condominium residents were killed and another resident was seriously injured during a shooting at Bellaria Residences. Responding police shot and killed the perpetrator, who is excluded from NHIRA fatalities.

title: Edmonton Police Officers Shooting
venue: Apartment complex near 114 Avenue and 132 Street
description: Two Edmonton Police Service officers were fatally shot while responding to a family dispute. The perpetrator subsequently died by suicide. The victim count excludes the perpetrator.

title: Ottawa Wedding Celebration Shooting
description: Four people were wounded in a shooting connected to a wedding celebration in Ottawa.

title: Mississauga Queensway East Shooting
venue: Commercial plaza near Queensway East and Stanfield Road
description: Four people suffered gunshot wounds during a shooting at a commercial plaza in Mississauga on Canada Day.

title: Ottawa Infinity Centre Wedding Shooting
description: Gunfire erupted among people gathered for a wedding celebration near the Infinity Convention Centre in Ottawa. Two victims were killed and six others were wounded.

title: Vaughan Casa Nova Drive Shooting
venue: Residential home on Casa Nova Drive
description: Four members of a family were shot inside a Vaughan residence. Two victims died and two others survived with serious injuries. Police described the victims as targeted.

title: Brampton Rutherford Road Shooting
venue: Commercial complex near Rutherford Road South
description: Four people were shot after another vehicle approached a parked vehicle at a Brampton commercial plaza. One woman was killed and three other victims were injured.

title: Toronto Lawrence Heights Shooting
description: Four people were wounded during a gang-related shooting near Marlee Avenue and Glencairn Avenue. More than 30 shots were fired and one victim was an innocent bystander.

title: McGradie's Tap & Grill Shooting
description: Five men were shot during an early-morning shooting at McGradie's Tap & Grill near Victoria Park Avenue and Ellesmere Road. None of the injuries were reported as life-threatening.

title: Queen Street East Restaurant Shooting
description: A shooting inside a restaurant at 235 Queen Street East killed one victim and wounded four others.

title: Etobicoke West Deane Park Shooting
venue: West Deane Park Drive and Rabbit Lane
description: Four men were found in a vehicle after gunfire near West Deane Park Drive and Rabbit Lane. Two victims died at the scene and two others were hospitalized with life-threatening injuries.

title: Pickering Shooting
description: Four people were injured during a shooting in Pickering, Ontario.
sources: List of Mass Shootings in Canada

title: Hamilton East Avenue Shooting
venue: East Avenue North near King Street East
description: One man was killed and three other people were wounded in an early-morning shooting on East Avenue North in Hamilton.

title: Edmonton Ertale Lounge Shooting
description: Seven people were shot near the Ertale Lounge in north-central Edmonton. One victim died and six others were injured.

title: Winnipeg Langside Street Shooting
description: Five people were shot on Langside Street in Winnipeg. Four victims ultimately died and one victim remained hospitalized with critical injuries.

title: White Rock Roper Avenue Shooting
description: Four men were seriously injured during a targeted shooting near Roper Avenue and Lee Street in White Rock.

title: Carry the Kettle Nakoda Nation Quadruple Homicide
description: Four victims were found deceased inside a residence on Carry the Kettle Nakoda Nation. Police investigated the deaths as homicides and subsequently charged multiple individuals with first-degree murder.
sources: File Hills First Nations Police Service

title: Piper Arms Pub Shooting
description: Three masked gunmen opened fire inside the Piper Arms Pub during its opening night in Scarborough. Twelve people were injured and no victims died.

title: Lawrence Heights Shooting
venue: Ranee Avenue and Varna Drive area
description: Three suspects allegedly approached a group and opened fire in Toronto's Lawrence Heights area. One 31-year-old victim died and five others were transported to hospital.

title: Big Island Lake Cree Nation Shooting
description: A shooting on Big Island Lake Cree Nation resulted in one victim being killed and three others being injured. The incident triggered a dangerous persons alert while police searched for two suspects.

title: Tumbler Ridge Mass Shooting
venue: Tumbler Ridge Secondary School and residential home
description: A gunman killed two family members at a nearby home before attacking Tumbler Ridge Secondary School. Eight victims died across the two locations and 27 people were injured. The perpetrator died by suicide and is excluded from NHIRA fatalities.
